Name: Burning Ammunition
Description: You touch an ammunition container or belt containing arrows or bolts. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using a piece of ammunition drawn from the container or belt, the target takes an extra 1d6 fire damage. The spell’s magic ends on a piece of ammunition when it hits or misses, and the spell ends when twelve pieces of ammunition have been drawn.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you may choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 3rd:

• The number of pieces of ammunition you can affect with this spell increases by 2.
• The extra fire damage becomes 1d8 (1 slot level), 1d10 (2 additional slot levels), 1d12 (3 slot levels), or 2d8 (4 slot levels).
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
